arxiv-2103-02273.title: On-sky measurements of atmospheric dispersion: II. Atmospheric models characterization 2020 On-sky measurements of atmospheric dispersion: II. Atmospheric models characterization – References
arxiv-2103-02273.creator: B. Wehbe, A. Cabral, L. Sbordone, G.Ávila
arxiv-2103-02273.description: Abstract Differential atmospheric dispersion is a wavelength-dependent effect introduced by Earth’s atmosphere that affects astronomical observations performed using ground-based telescopes. It is important, when observing at a zenithal angle different from zero, to use an Atmospheric Dispersion Corrector (ADC) to compensate this atmospheric dispersion.

arxiv-2107-10335.title: Stochastic Relaxed Inertial Forward-Backward-Forward splitting for Monotone Inclusions in Hilbert spaces
arxiv-2107-10335.creator: Shisheng Cui, Uday V. Shanbhag, Mathias Staudigl, Phan Tu Vuong
arxiv-2107-10335.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Shisheng Cui, Uday V. Shanbhag, Mathias Staudigl, Phan Tu Vuong. We consider monotone inclusions defined on a Hilbert space where the operator is given by the sum of a maximal monotone operator T T and a single-valued monotone, Lipschitz continuous, and expectation-valued operator V V . We draw motivation from the seminal work by Attouch and Cabot [ 1 , 2 ] on relaxed inertial methods for monotone inclusions and present a stochastic extension of the relaxed inertial forward-backward-forward (RISFBF) method.

arxiv-2211-10816.title: Regularidade do Sistema de Timoshenko com Termoelasticidade do Tipo III e Amortecimento Fracionário Regularity of the Timoshenko’s System with Thermoelasticity of Type III and Fractional Damping
arxiv-2211-10816.creator: Filomena Barbosa Rodrigues Mendes
arxiv-2211-10816.description: Abstract The article presents the study of the regularity of two thermoelastic beam systems defined by the Timoshenko beam model coupled with the heat conduction of Green-Naghdiy theory of type III, both mathematical models are differentiated by their coupling terms that arise as a consequence of the constitutive laws initially considered.

arxiv-2303-02525.title: Prompt Detection of Fast Optical Bursts with the Vera C. Rubin Observatory Journal: Astrophysical Journal Batoid ( Meyers et al. 2019 ) , Galsim ( Rowe et al. 2015 ) , IPython ( Pérez & Granger 2007 ) Matplotlib ( Hunter 2007 ) , NumPy ( Harris et al. 2020 ) , PyTorch ( Paszke et al. 2019 )
arxiv-2303-02525.creator: Guillem Megias Homar, Joshua M. Meyers, Steven M. Kahn
arxiv-2303-02525.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Guillem Megias Homar, Joshua M. Meyers, Steven M. Kahn. The transient optical sky has remained largely unexplored on very short timescales. While there have been some experiments searching for optical transients from minutes to years, none have had the capability to distinguish millisecond Fast Optical Bursts (FOB). Such very fast transients could be the optical counterparts of Fast Radio Bursts (FRB), the prompt emission from γ \gamma ‐Ray Bursts (GRB), or other previously unknown phenomena.

arxiv-2307-12854.title: Multiscale Video Pretraining for Long-Term Activity Forecasting
arxiv-2307-12854.creator: Reuben Tan Matthias De Lange Michael Iuzzolino Bryan A. Plummer, Kate Saenko Karl Ridgeway Lorenzo Torresani
arxiv-2307-12854.description: Abstract Long-term activity forecasting is an especially challenging research problem because it requires understanding the temporal relationships between observed actions, as well as the variability and complexity of human activities. Despite relying on strong supervision via expensive human annotations, state-of-the-art forecasting approaches often generalize poorly to unseen data.

arxiv-2502-20089.title: RIZE: Regularized Imitation Learning via Distributional Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2502-20089.creator: Adib Karimi, Mohammad Mehdi Ebadzadeh
arxiv-2502-20089.description: Abstract We introduce a novel Inverse Reinforcement Learning (IRL) approach that overcomes limitations of fixed reward assignments and constrained flexibility in implicit reward regularization. By extending the Maximum Entropy IRL framework with a squared temporal-difference (TD) regularizer and adaptive targets, dynamically adjusted during training, our method indirectly optimizes a reward function while incorporating reinforcement learning principles.

pmc-10755199.title: Resection rates and intention-to-treat outcomes in borderline and locally advanced pancreatic cancer: real-world data from a population-based, prospective cohort study (NORPACT-2)
pmc-10755199.creator: Ingvild Farnes, Dyre Kleive, Caroline S Verbeke, Lars Aabakken, Aart Issa-Epe, Milada Cvancarova Småstuen, Bjarte V Fosby, Svein Dueland, Pål-Dag Line, Knut J Labori
pmc-10755199.description: BackgroundSystemic chemotherapy is the initial treatment strategy for borderline resectable and locally advanced pancreatic cancer to facilitate curative resection. pmc-11645905.title: Mediating Role of Psychological Resilience Between Depression and Quality of Life in Maintenance Hemodialysis Patients in Baoding City, China: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-11645905.creator: Na Li
pmc-11645905.description: ObjectivePatients with end-stage renal disease (ESRD) are at an increased risk for emotional issues, with depression being the most prevalent psychological concern, significantly impacting their quality of life. This study aimed to explore the mediating effect of psychological resilience on the relationship between depression and quality of life in maintenance hemodialysis (MHD) patients.

pmc-12417248.title: Intravascular Papillary Endothelial Hyperplasia (Masson’s Tumor) of the Thumb Presenting as a Giant Cell Tumor of Tendon Sheath: A Case Report and Literature Review
pmc-12417248.creator: Grigorios Kastanis, Constantinos Chaniotakis, Konstantinos Zampetakis, Nikolaos Ritzakis, Ioannis Ktistakis
pmc-12417248.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Masson's tumor, also known as intravascular papillary endothelial hyperplasia (IPEH), is a rare benign vascular lesion of the skin and subcutaneous tissues. It represents the organization and recanalization of a thrombus within a normal vessel, vascular malformation, or hematoma. Although it can occur in any part of the body, its presence in the hand can be particularly challenging to differentiate from other soft-tissue lesions. We present a case of Masson's tumor located in the distal phalanx of the thumb.

pmc-12595797.title: Predictive determinants of CIN II + lesions in women over 65 years old: the contribution of HPV, colposcopy, and double immunostaining techniques
pmc-12595797.creator: Gozde Sahin, Filiz Yuksel Ulu, Ilkbal Temel Yuksel
pmc-12595797.description: BackgroundCervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade II or higher (CIN II+) is hard to diagnose in women over 65 years of age since age-related anatomical changes take place, and there is a paucity of data. The aim of the study was to identify predictive clinical, virological, colposcopic, and immunohistochemical predictors of CIN II + lesions in this less studied population.

pmc-12731601.creator: Satya Srirama Karthik Divvela, Eric Bekoe Offei, Hawi Kadr, Maximilian Hausherr, Britta Eggers, Svitlana Rozanova, Martin Eisenacher, Hoang Duy Nguyen, Tran Tuoc, Verian Bader, Xuesong Yang, Holm Zaehres, Anqi Chen, Huu Phuc Nguyen, Konstanze F. Winklhofer, Katrin Marcus, Beate Brand-Saberi
pmc-12731601.description: The basic helix-loop-helix (bHLH) transcription factor ‘Atoh8’ is involved in the regulation of several developmental processes and pathologies. It regulates organogenesis, reprogramming, stem cell fate determination, and cancer development. However, the mechanisms underlying these observations remain unclear. Unlike many tissue-specific bHLH factors, Atoh8 is ubiquitously expressed during development as well as in adult tissues.
